description:
Use when someone has a link to a Facebook group or post and wants to know whether that group is an official Moda group.
link: the facebook.com/groups/... address or a facebook.com/share/... link. Share links are opened on Moda's servers to find the group they point to.
Returns JSON with verdict official, not_official or could_not_check, the group's name when it is official, and a plain sentence to pass on.

link.description: A Facebook group, post or share link.

name: check_facebook_group_link
title: Check a Facebook group link
